summary: The claim between the engine and expected points is inconclusive. The shared 2022-23 total of -477 is an arithmetic equivalence: dynamic transfers gained 267 under both scores, and the weeks are not the same series. Eligible weeks need populated xG and a prior season, so 2022-23 drops out of that second table and stays in the all-weeks pool. Every eligible score_xp-minus-expected-points interval covers zero. From gameweek 6 the live squad uses captured ep_next, and the shadow log still scores score_xp beside it.
